name: Outlaw Tools v0.7.1
body:
# Outlaw Tools v0.7.1

Public downloads for Outlaw Tools by Orbital Outlaws. Mining Scanner is the first complete module in the wider companion app.

Product home: https://www.orbitaloutlaws.tv/

Source repository: private (PattrnData/Outlaw-Tools)

# Outlaw Tools v0.7.1

## Prices And Roadmap

- Preserve fractional UEX resource prices from download through local cache, numeric sorting, resource views and scanner result cards.
- Keep unavailable prices separate from explicit zero quotes and retain compatibility with older resource caches.
- Refuse ambiguous raw/refined commodity mappings instead of selecting the last matching name.
- Update the in-app roadmap with the complete product direction: read-only UEX and Marketplace next, dedicated Routes, then staged Link, custom Decks, Stream Deck integration and reviewed keybind controls.
- Broader inventory, crafting, Blueprint/Mission, fleet, mining analysis, Cargo/Salvage and accessibility improvements remain visible as separate useful releases.
- This is the first UEX precision slice. The broader economy cache, Marketplace browser and Routes workspace remain upcoming. Player data and own-PC sync are unchanged.

## Downloads

- Windows: `OutlawTools-Setup-0.7.1.exe` and SHA-256 checksum.
- Linux: `OutlawTools-linux-x86_64-0.7.1.tar.gz` and SHA-256 checksum.
